free_tier.stated: No sign-up: the public pool allows 5 requests a second for a single record and 1 a second for lists of records, 1 at a time; the polite pool, selected by an email address in the mailto parameter or the agent header, allows 10 a second for a single DOI record and 3 a second for lists, 3 at a time; no daily cap is published
free_tier.notes: The limits come back in the x-rate-limit-limit, x-rate-limit-interval and x-concurrency-limit response headers; an anonymous list call on 2026-10-31 answered x-rate-limit-limit 1, x-rate-limit-interval 1s and x-concurrency-limit 1 in pool public-array.

per_object_cap.stated: rows maximum 1000 per call; rows=1000 with a five-field select returned 773,304 bytes in one response on 2026-10-31

retention.stated: the registry only grows; records are corrected rather than deleted, and the API is the live view

egress.terms: Free and unmetered. No key, no account, no allowance published.

interface_detail: GET https://api.crossref.org/works with rows, cursor and select; content negotiation for single records. The polite pool is signalled with mailto= or a User-Agent carrying an address.
tooling: curl/python-requests; the harvester package and the documented cursor pattern. No SDK required.
chaining: Crossref supplies the DOI-level citation graph and licence metadata; the full text behind each DOI is a separate fetch from the publisher or from an OA mirror such as PMC or Europe PMC.

limits.value: public pool: 5 requests a second for a single record, 1 a second for lists of records, concurrency 1; polite pool (an email address in mailto or the agent header): 10 a second for a single DOI record, 3 a second for lists, concurrency 3
rows maximum 1000 per call, cursor paging beyond; rows=1000 with a five-field select returned 773,304 bytes on 2026-10-31

limits_note: Monthly snapshots are a Metadata Plus benefit fetched with a Crossref-Plus-API-Token header; the free bulk path is the annual public data file over Academic Torrents. Without a token, a HEAD of the documented URL https://api.crossref.org/snapshots/monthly/latest/all.json.tar.gz answered 200 with a zero-byte text/html body on 2026-10-31.
binding_note: One list call a second in the public pool, or 3 in the polite pool, each of at most 1000 rows, decides how many records a day the API yields; the annual public data file is the route to the whole registry.

identity_cost.detail: No signup or registration. An email address in the mailto parameter or the agent header selects the polite pool with higher limits; it is not a credential. Metadata Plus is an annual subscription that issues an API key.

reliability_note: Over the rate limit answers 429; a manual block answers 403 and is lifted through support. Without a Metadata Plus token the monthly snapshot URLs answer 200 with an empty or stub HTML body instead of an error, so a client must check the bytes it saves.
confidence_note: The pool limits are vendor pages read on 2026-10-31; an anonymous list call and an anonymous single-DOI call the same day returned the public-pool limits in their headers, and a rows=1000 call returned 773,304 bytes. The published limits were not tested at their ceiling.
